title: Concept: SQL built by concatenation (ruby) — review required
description: In ruby, .executes*((?:[^()]|([^()]*))*(?:+|#{) mixes code and data in one SQL string. Concatenation is the classic injection primitive: quotes and keywords in the input rewrite the statement. The remedy is bound parameters via bound parameters.
applicability: ruby codebases issuing SQL through the flagged call; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Full database compromise (read, write, execute) when untrusted input reaches the query; HIGH severity.
